narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video features professional baseball players discussing the reality of their career path. They explain why they wouldn't necessarily encourage their children to follow in their footsteps, highlighting the extreme difficulty of reaching the professional level (the 'pyramid' effect) and the importance of having an education and diverse skills to rely on if a sports career fails.
